info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Payments Payments Void-v1-spec
info.description: The Void Payments API enables businesses to cancel previously initiated payment transactions efficiently. This endpoint is designed for managing payment void requests, allowing users to reverse payments that are no longer required. Common use cases involve payment processing systems and financial applications where transaction integrity is critical. Users, such as payment processors and e-commerce platforms, can leverage this API to ensure accurate financial reporting and customer service.

delete.description: This operation allows you to void a payment transaction, reversing it and ensuring that the funds are returned to the payer. It is essential for managing payment disputes or errors.

requestBody.description: Request body to void a payment. This operation will remove the designated payment from the system and is often used to correct errors or prevent further processing of a transaction.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.title: Void Payment Deletion Request Body
DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: The request body for voiding a payment operation. It is presented as a string.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Payment Void Response

status.description: Indicates if the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the original payment transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of this void operation.

state.description: The current state of the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the void operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful payment void operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the void operation record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the void operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit of the void operation.

schema.description: The time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request.
